scope: Read-only implementation-scope audit for one independently selected architecture q004 development pair; no implementation, dispatch, inference, answers, quality reviews or raw trial streams read.
head: 8985de20b68a34989a7e0f74c4d3e850ea1684c9
conclusion: Reuse generic source exporter and existing paired runner unchanged. Add an independently named and frozen single-case phase at workflow/CI orchestration boundaries, new dataset/task/evaluator assets, and focused gate/wiring tests. Do not extend any prior frozen phase or dataset.

proposed_phase_contract.embedding_default_recommendation: Keep current executable main local default local/potion-code-16m-v2 so the case is the declared changed factor. This is a recommendation, not a new frozen choice; if remote retrieval is chosen, declare it in this new plan and deliberately reuse remote infrastructure helpers without activating the old q001-only remote phase.
proposed_phase_contract.freeze_rule: Prepared frozen=false until independent case selection, neutral question, full source inventory, evidence/rubric validation, current-main identity check and independent wiring review are complete. New outputs never authorize extra runs under old plans.

anchors: provider-probe Resolve frozen task selection before provider calls
changes: Add task zvec-q004 and independent architecture_pilot boolean default false. Keep both mapping exactly reflex-6 and zvec-q001.

Add PILOT_ARCHITECTURE flag to selection; accept only q004 + architecture=true + completion=true + all other phase flags false, produce exactly [zvec-q004]; reject q004 without phase and architecture with any old task.
Call shared new phase validator before Qwen provider probe. Do not merely rely on CI wrapper after provider calls.
Pass --architecture-pilot only for that new flag. Repeats remains 1 and job timeout 45 minutes.
Keep fork-only job guards, fail-fast false, always-run collection/redaction/upload and existing secret mappings unchanged for the recommended local phase.

anchors: main argument and pre-setup gates lines 168-227
changes: Accept q004 and --architecture-pilot. Reject all nonexclusive flag/task/repeat combinations before work directory creation, network, indexing or model calls. Preserve legacy branches.
Add validate_architecture_plan (or import one small phase-specific helper if validation readability requires it), shared with workflow.
Load q004 repository/revision/prompt from its new dataset; pass prepare_corpus.py --dataset <new manifest> --task q004. Do not route q004 into q001 fallback.
Copy the new phase plan and dataset into reports; set phase=architecture-development, architecture_plan metadata with hashes, planned count=2 and baseline then zg.

Reuse existing upstream_protocol, native runtime verification, index, preflight, unchanged run.py invocation, collect_evidence and source manifest logic. Runner model/budgets/tools/common instructions must remain unchanged.

Add negative phase/input/repeat matrix at workflow and wrapper level, shared frozen-plan/hash gate tests, exact q004 source/export/plan provenance and unchanged solver invocation checks. Keep existing legacy tests unchanged except any environment fixture explicitly needing PILOT_ARCHITECTURE=false.
Prefer isolated new test_architecture.py if this avoids rewriting the large established test_wrapper.py fixtures; exactly one of these files needs new coverage.
Document new explicit single-case invocation, separate phase identity, frozen-before-run requirement, result location and quality/resources interpretation. No historical result rewriting.
Document q004 selected task type and separate development dataset after independent selection is known; preserve previous dataset definitions and caveats.

necessary_new_assets.content: Independent agent/retrieval/protocol/source references, runtime pin, run count/order, dispatch inputs, predeclared source-grounded primary endpoint, resource metrics, independent review requirements, no automatic replacement/repeat and freeze status.

Exactly one q004 task with full commit SHA, repository, neutral instruction/evaluator file hashes, full inventory hash/count, known leakage markers and selection/inference disclosure. Existing exporter schema is sufficient.
Independently selected neutral question only. No evaluator, issue-resolution clue, retrieval instruction or outcome-derived search hint.

task_id=q004, exact source_commit and evidence_spans with file/span SHA, explicit source-grounded criteria/critical errors/citation gates. Existing exporter requires these keys but does not constrain question type.
Selection record, issue/fix source provenance, independent task/source review and verified export evidence. Evaluator-only directory never mounted into solver.

new_validator_requirements: Fail if plan is not explicitly frozen=true, exact experiment/phase/task identity is wrong, or dataset contains anything except one q004 task.

Validate dataset hash and local question/evaluator hash against it before provider calls; source commit, repository and dataset identifiers must agree with plan. Actual Git archive/inventory/span validation stays in generic exporter before solver.
Validate frozen completion protocol values, hook hash and computed common_instructions(False,24,600) SHA; do not require q004 task to equal q001 base task as remote_embedding.validate_plan does.
Validate plan against exact permitted inputs, repeats=1,start_repeat=1,total count=2, baseline then zg and disabled auto repeat/expansion/replacement. CLI request must agree.

Validate declared native runtime/package and selected embedding against this phase runtime selection. Rechecking current upstream main is an external pre-freeze observation, not a claim established solely by the old constant.
Hash references to source/wiring validation and selection policy if used as freeze prerequisites; retain those outside source.

reusable_without_edit.evidence: select_task and --dataset/--task accept new task IDs; validates question/evaluator hash, exact commit, safe full archive, evaluator identity, spans, full inventory and leakage markers; keeps manifest outside source.
Task-agnostic source/prompt inputs; trial_plan(1,1) yields baseline then zg; same complete usage accounting, failure retention and trial isolation. No new task enum or quality scoring in runner.
Generic completion budget already enforces 24 calls/600 seconds through existing invocation; no task-specific mutation needed.
Generic root/index preflight; do not replace its neutral source code implementation query with q004-specific evidence.
Unchanged if local default chosen. Existing validator is intentionally q001-specific and must not be weakened/reused as authority for q004.
Existing tests establish full planned pair order, preserve model failure and remaining planned trials, and stop on infrastructure failure. No new controller needed.

current_main_and_historical_replay.current_main_action: Read authoritative upstream main HEAD before freeze. If equal to observed pin, no Docker/runtime changes required. Record time/SHA in the new plan.
current_main_and_historical_replay.if_main_advanced: Do not globally overwrite UPSTREAM_COMMIT, prepare_rust_runtime.py package pin, Docker checksum/label or workflow artifact run for every phase. Add explicit new-phase runtime manifest/selection while keeping legacy default exact, or an isolated versioned runtime path. Validate native artifact package and binary SHA and complete version/MCP checks. Build/test only on Cuiyus/zvec-grep; existing upstream artifact download is read-only.

verification_before_dispatch: Execute exhaustive new flag/task/repeat negative tests at both workflow script and ci_run; assert no provider/setup invocation or work directory creation on invalid input.
Fail before provider on unfrozen plan, changed dataset/question/rubric/hook/instructions/runtime/input/count; verify correct frozen plan advances to setup exactly once.

Fake-command wrapper test verifies q004 selected revision and prompt, generic exporter explicit --dataset/--task, setup phase/count/order/plan hashes and exact unchanged solver model/MCP/budget/turn/wall args.

Export exact q004 source once into a new isolated path and validate entire inventory, evidence spans, no .git, no forbidden markers or evaluator directories. Exporter unit suite already covers malformed IDs/paths/symlinks/hash drift.
Run existing pilot and exporter offline suites to ensure legacy invocation combinations and original q001 manifest bytes remain unchanged. Do not substitute tests for actual source review.
Compare existing frozen plan/dataset/question/rubric hashes and relevant legacy run command semantics against pre-change HEAD.
Run protocol offline probes already in workflow; native inventory Read/Grep/Glob for both and exact Rust MCP additional tool for zg only.

Baseline test confirms no zg seed/home grant/index, no embedding environment, empty strict MCP configuration and read-only empty index overlay. Both have fresh HOME, no prior answers, no evaluator/Git/benchmarks mounts and identical neutral instructions.

Ensure existing collect-only path retains complete or partial stream/metrics/answer/command/budget evidence, scrubs known secrets and does not upload runtime/session/index seeds. CI failure still executes collection.

Verify source-grounded quality judged blind with final answers plus frozen source/rubric only. Judge cannot see arm mapping/resources/older answers. Resource accounting and retrieval adoption checked independently after unblinding.

quality_and_resource_reporting.primary: Per-task source_grounded_success under frozen q004 rubric; report all criteria, citations and unsupported claims. Selection rule and interpretation must be declared before seeing any q004 solver results.
secondary: successful correct-root zg retrieval and useful returned evidence
quality_and_resource_reporting.interpretation: Do not build token reduction into the meaning of source-grounded success. Separately state whether quality improves, matches, or falls and whether tokens/wall improve or increase. Preserve both complete/failed answers; lower tokens on incomplete usage or failed answers are not efficiency evidence. One purposively selected pair is exploratory and not a stable suite/generalization claim.
quality_and_resource_reporting.failure_policy: Retain timeout/model failure as planned outcome and run other arm when protocol allows. Infrastructure/isolation/secret failures stop affected pair and retain partial evidence; no automatic repeat or replacement.

avoidable_duplication: No second paired runner, Docker trial loop, stream parser, budget hook, source exporter or secret scanner.
No copied evaluator/gold inside runtime image or solver source.
No broad phase abstraction refactor is necessary; a small explicit new phase is easiest to compare against historical semantics.
No special architecture retrieval query, additional root guidance or changed MCP description; those are additional factors and cannot silently enter q004.
No new GitHub workflow required while current workflow remains readable and fork-only gating is preserved.
not_performed: No answer files, quality review outputs or raw trial streams read
